source_claim: AlphaEvolve-scale evaluation artifacts should be promotion-ready evidence, so validator-boundary consistency checks must be distinguished from optional CLI inspection when archival or release gates are not enforced.
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve validates manifest-backed run artifacts with libreevolve.run_artifact_validator_boundary_consistency.v1, checks policies.validator_execution, scans history.jsonl and failure_history.jsonl attempts, rejects missing validator_boundary metadata, rejects mismatched policy/boundary claims, rejects manifest-backed legacy rows, runs the gate through libreevolve show, and reports stream/line diagnostics. It does not claim run-finalization enforcement, CI artifact-promotion enforcement, release-artifact promotion enforcement, historical bundle batch enforcement, or archival blocking policy.
